remarks: Every image has a text alternative, and decorative images are hidden from screen readers.
The product has no audio-only or video-only content.
The product has no prerecorded video.
The product has no prerecorded video.
The product has no live video.
The product has no prerecorded video.
Headings, lists, tables and form fields are marked up as such.
The reading order of every page follows its visual order.
No instruction relies on shape or position alone.
Every page works in portrait and landscape.
Fields for the user's name, email and address name their purpose.
Overdue invoices are marked by a word as well as a colour.
The product plays no audio.
Body text meets the ratio. The "Draft" badge on unsent invoices measures 3.1 to 1.
Text can be enlarged to 200 percent with browser zoom without loss of content.
The product shows no images of text.
Every page reflows to a width of 320 CSS pixels.
Controls and focus indicators meet the 3 to 1 ratio.
Tooltips stay while hovered, and Escape dismisses them.
Every function can be operated from a keyboard.
Focus never becomes trapped, in dialogs included.
The product has no single-character keyboard shortcuts.
The session warns before it times out and can be extended.
Nothing on the product's pages moves or updates on its own.
Nothing on the product's pages flashes.
A "Skip to content" link starts every page.
Every page has a title naming the page and the product.
Every page can be reached from the menu, and from search.
The product's style sheet removes the browser's focus outline, and nothing replaces it.
The page's header never covers the focused control.
Level AAA; not evaluated.
No function uses a path-based or multipoint gesture.
Controls act when the pointer is released.
No function is operated by moving the device.
No function needs dragging.
Every target is at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels.
The product's text is all in one language.
The menu is in the same place and order on every page.
The help link is in the same place on every page.
A field in error is named, and the error is described in text.
Errors say what was expected, such as a date's format.
An invoice can be reviewed before it is sent and recalled for ten minutes after.
The product never asks for the same information twice in one process.
Signing in allows a password manager and pasting, and asks no cognitive test.
Every control is a native one, or exposes its name, role and state.
Saved and sent messages are announced as status messages.
